title: Group Fitness Class Passes: the club membership required to purchase a pack
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for the club membership a member must hold in order to purchase a class-credit pack, across every tier of the product.

## Basis
A class-credit pack may be purchased only by a member whose club membership is, at the time of purchase, in active status on the system record, and whose membership tier ladder rank is at least the purchasing tier's minimum required rank. A member whose membership is inactive, or whose membership tier ladder rank falls below the tier's minimum, must first upgrade or reactivate their membership before the pack may be purchased.

## Points of judgement
- The evidentiary basis is the membership status and rank held on the system record for that member, not the member's own statement of their membership standing.
- A minimum required rank of 0 is satisfied by any active membership regardless of its rank; a tier setting a higher minimum rank excludes an active membership whose rank falls below it, even though that membership is otherwise in good standing.
